ana: Heads-up — Legal + two EU pilot customers pushed for a formal 'regulatory onramp' lane that maps jurisdictional constraints -> routing/slicing/SLA. Need a decision before Q3 planning.

jamal: Got it. Can you enumerate the asks? e.g. data residency, KMS/FIPS, dedicated tenancy, longer audit retention? And do customers want strict per-org isolation or region-based?

sofia: Quick proposal for discussion: tiered lanes. 1) Hosted+residency+KMS (low friction). 2) Dedicated pools with SLA + soft isolation. 3) Private VPC/on-prem for full compliance. Each lane needs explicit launch criteria: perf SLOs, acceptance tests, ops runbook, and legal signoff.

luke: +1. Rollout checklist should include canary (3 customers), automatic fallback path to default model/region, and runbook for escalation. Commercial needs 99.95% target for Dedicated lane in the contract template.

priya: CS note — Customer "EcoBank EU" expects a migration window in their PO and credits if we miss cutover SLAs. Also they require preflight validation for their prompts. We should surface migration automation as a blocker if not ready.

jamal: Infra deps I see: routing DSL extension (policy predicates for jurisdiction and entitlements), region affinity tagging, isolated capacity pools, quota shaping, and telemetry hooks for lineage + audit logs. Rough timeline: core routing + DSL ~6w, audit log pipeline ~4w, KMS integration + rotation + HSM config ~3w, dedicated autoscaling knobs ~3w. (rough order-of-magnitude)

ana: (typo fix) ana: prioritization question — which item unblocks the most customers / biggest sales friction? My read: KMS + data residency (hosted lane) clears the largest number of pilot deals quickly. Dedicated/isolation are bigger infra efforts.

sofia: I'll draft a concrete launch-criteria checklist. First pass items: SLA baseline (uptime & p99), perf certification (p95 latency < 120ms for routing path), policy tests (unit + e2e), residency verification (data in region), KMS with key rotation and audit, audit-log retention 1y, canary customers, billing/contract addendum. Example policy snippet for the DSL: `policy: { \"region\": \"eu\", \"isolation\": \"dedicated\", \"audit_retention_days\": 365 }`.

luke: Can we align timelines with Dedicated roadmap? cc @eng-runtime @eng-infra. Also commercial wants a default cost estimate + recommended quantization profile for Dedicated to help pricing.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: created tracking ticket REG-3200 "regulatory-onramp: policy + infra + commercial alignment" — assignee: jamal. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/REG-3200

ana: (again) ana: Action items: Sofia -> publish checklist doc and owner; Jamal -> detailed infra estimates + known blockers; Luke -> commercial requirements + sample contract clause; Priya -> shortlist 3 canary customers and permission to run tests. Goal: converge on prioritization decision in planning sync (target ts 1951234700).

jamal: I'll push a short RFC today with dependency graph and a minimal MVP plan that unblocks hosted residency + KMS first.

sofia: I'll drop the checklist into product/roadmaps/regulatory-onramp and ping here when ready.

luke: Thanks — will prep one-slide for planning sync focusing on sales impact and cost delta.

priya: I'll reach out to EcoBank and two other pilots to ask about canary windows.

ana: Awesome. :thumbsup:
